newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGB futures pare most gains on long liquidation.
newsitem.headline: JGB futures pare most gains on long liquidation.

text.p: The key June Japanese government bond (JGB) futures contract ended slightly higher in Tokyo on Monday, but off its earlier high.
Traders said the key contract pared gains as several large-lot sell orders totalling over 100 billion yen emerged before the close, forcing some dealers to liquidate their long positions.
The June hit an intraday low of 125.22 shortly before the close but managed to close 0.07 higher at 125.38. It rose as high as 125.58 in early morning trade.
Turnover of the June contract was 45,010.
